task.maidpatina.rust_removal.desc: Finds nearby oxidized copper and removes one oxidation stage.
task.maidpatina.waxing.desc: Finds nearby waxable blocks and applies wax.
task.maidpatina.advanced_honey.desc: Helps a bee gather nectar from an offhand or head-display flower, then deposit it at the main-hand hive.
task.maidpatina.advanced_honey.condition: Requires a beehive or bee nest in the main hand
Requires a bee-accepted flower in the offhand or head-display slot
Requires shears or a glass bottle in the backpack
